title: "4.GO_Slim"
output: html_document

```{r}

# GO Slim ORA Dotplots + CSV export (BP / CC / MF)


# Libraries

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(DOSE)
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
})


# Paths (explicit)

input_dir  <- "results/03_volcano_plot"
output_dir <- "results/04_GO_slim_ORA"
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

input_file <- file.path(input_dir,"deseq2_results_filtered.csv")

# Load data
df <- read_csv(input_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Use ALL genes (already filtered for significance)
genes_ensg <- unique(df$gene_id)

# Map Ensembl -> Entrez
gene_map <- bitr(
  genes_ensg,
  fromType = "ENSEMBL",
  toType   = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db
)

entrez_genes <- unique(gene_map$ENTREZID)

# Download & parse GO Slim generic term set
slim_url <- "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/subsets/goslim_generic.obo"
slim_obo <- readLines(slim_url)

term_starts <- which(slim_obo == "[Term]")

slim_info <- lapply(term_starts, function(i) {
  block     <- slim_obo[i:min(i + 25, length(slim_obo))]
  id_line   <- grep("^id: GO:", block, value = TRUE)[1]
  name_line <- grep("^name: ",  block, value = TRUE)[1]
  ns_line   <- grep("^namespace: ", block, value = TRUE)[1]
  if (!is.na(id_line)) {
    data.frame(
      GOID      = sub("^id: ", "", id_line),
      name      = sub("^name: ", "", name_line),
      namespace = sub("^namespace: ", "", ns_line),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}) %>% bind_rows()

message("GO Slim terms loaded: ", nrow(slim_info),
        " (BP=", sum(slim_info$namespace == "biological_process"),
        ", CC=", sum(slim_info$namespace == "cellular_component"),
        ", MF=", sum(slim_info$namespace == "molecular_function"), ")")

# Split slim terms by ontology
slim_by_ont <- list(
  BP = slim_info %>% filter(namespace == "biological_process"),
  CC = slim_info %>% filter(namespace == "cellular_component"),
  MF = slim_info %>% filter(namespace == "molecular_function")
)

# Build gene-to-GO mappings (all propagated annotations)
go_data <- AnnotationDbi::toTable(org.Hs.egGO2ALLEGS)
# Columns: gene_id, go_id, Evidence, Ontology

# GO Slim ORA function (using enricher with custom term sets)
run_go_slim <- function(ont_code) {

  slim_ids <- slim_by_ont[[ont_code]]

  ont_map <- c(BP = "BP", CC = "CC", MF = "MF")

  term2gene <- go_data %>%
    filter(go_id %in% slim_ids$GOID, Ontology == ont_map[[ont_code]]) %>%
    dplyr::select(go_id, gene_id) %>%
    distinct()

  term2name <- slim_ids %>%
    dplyr::select(GOID, name) %>%
    distinct()

  res <- enricher(
    gene         = entrez_genes,
    TERM2GENE    = term2gene,
    TERM2NAME    = term2name,
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    qvalueCutoff = 1
  )

  if (!is.null(res)) {
    res <- setReadable(res, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")
  }
  res
}

# Run GO Slim enrichment
ego_BP <- run_go_slim("BP")
ego_CC <- run_go_slim("CC")
ego_MF <- run_go_slim("MF")

# Function to save enrichment results as CSV
save_go_csv <- function(ego, ontology_label) {
  ego_df <- as.data.frame(ego)
  if (nrow(ego_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  write.csv(
    ego_df,
    file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("GOSlim_", ontology_label, "_results.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

# Save CSVs
save_go_csv(ego_BP, "Biological_Process")
save_go_csv(ego_CC, "Cellular_Component")
save_go_csv(ego_MF, "Molecular_Function")

# Function to create dotplots
make_go_dotplot <- function(ego, ontology_label) {

  ego_df <- as.data.frame(ego)
  if (nrow(ego_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  p <- dotplot(
    ego,
    showCategory = 20,
    font.size = 12
  ) +
    ggtitle(paste("GO Slim", ontology_label, "Enrichment")) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  # Save PDF
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0("GOSlim_", ontology_label, "_dotplot.pdf")
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = 6.5,
    height = 8
  )

  # Save PNG (NEW)
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0("GOSlim_", ontology_label, "_dotplot.png")
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = 6.5,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

# Generate dotplots
make_go_dotplot(ego_BP, "Biological_Process")
make_go_dotplot(ego_CC, "Cellular_Component")
make_go_dotplot(ego_MF, "Molecular_Function")

message("GO Slim enrichment analysis complete. Dotplots + CSVs saved to: ", output_dir)

```
